what_the_gate_tests: winner's-curse-robust within-sequence generalization of event abundance from the screened (first) half to the unscreened (second) half of each selected sequence; full-range counts are reported, never gated, for downstream power accounting

candidate_pool.source: official DiVa-360 GitHub README sequence list (the same sanctioned source cycle 1 used)
candidate_pool.queue_rationale: name-prior ordering (placement-and-return semantics first); under the full-tranche halt rule the order affects only pool composition, never selection within the screened pool; residual pool-composition effect disclosed
candidate_pool.halt_rule: tranche 1 is screened IN FULL regardless of interim qualification; selection happens only over a fully screened tranche
candidate_pool.tranche_2_rule: tranche 2 = the next 20 unscreened candidates in candidates_short list order, then candidates_long list order; after any continuation, selection operates over ALL fully screened candidates (union of tranches); 'continue' at the checkpoint means: proceed to the gate if a passing subset already exists over the screened pool, else screen tranche 2
candidate_pool.long_sequence_deferral: all 8 long-duration candidates are deferred out of tranche 1 on duration-scaled cost grounds; this is part of the disclosed pool-composition effect of queue ordering

windows.screening_window: the FIRST floor(n/2) frames of the sequence's common frame range (n = common-range length); realized bounds recorded per candidate
windows.gate_window: the SECOND half (frames floor(n/2)..n-1) of each SELECTED sequence, computed from FULL-range tracks

boundary_conventions.return_attribution: a gate-window return is one whose terminating re-appearance run STARTS in the gate window; LTP lookup may reach into the screened half
boundary_conventions.occlusion_and_absence_attribution: occlusion runs and true-absence windows belong to the half containing their FIRST frame

windows.concordance_diagnostic: at gate time, screened-half statistics are recomputed from the full-range tracks of the selected sequences (CPU) and deltas reported next to the gate; diagnostic-only

statistics.definitions_base: prereg_m1_census_v1.json revision 3 (eligibility_predicate, association_rules, r_site_census, track_coverage_statistic) with the twelve frozen readings below

gate_bearing_return_statistic.name: union_return_count
gate_bearing_return_statistic.definition: primary consensus return (revision-3 rule, unchanged) OR R2-prime: >= 2 TRAINING cameras (held-out id = 0 mod 4 excluded), pairwise angular separation >= angular_floor, EACH having the identity's in-domain visible report pixel within a per-camera tolerance tol_c = r_site_census * f_c / z_c of the projection of the LTP into camera c (f_c = the camera's fl_x, z_c = the LTP's camera-frame depth), evaluated at the earliest frame of the terminating re-appearance run where the R2-prime condition holds. A camera c participates in R2-prime only if the LTP projects in c with camera-frame depth z_c > 0 (R7 depth clause); otherwise c is simply not counted toward the >= 2; the projection may fall outside image bounds (the in-domain requirement already binds the report pixel). Comparison details: the report point is the R8 round-half-up integer pixel; the distance is Euclidean 2-D; the comparison is inclusive (<= tol_c), mirroring R11
gate_bearing_return_statistic.angular_floor: the ceil(0.10 * N)-th smallest of the N = C(k,2) pairwise angular separations among training-camera optical axes (NEAREST-RANK, no interpolation), computed per sequence from shipped calibration only
gate_bearing_return_statistic.single_camera_form: the >= 1 camera variant is DIAGNOSTIC-ONLY, never gate-bearing, never selection-bearing
gate_bearing_return_statistic.selection_statistic_identity: the selection statistic IS the gate-bearing union statistic (frozen identity)
gate_bearing_return_statistic.loosening_disclosure: the union predicate is a post-outcome one-sided loosening motivated by the cycle-1 characterized censoring gap (70-109 undefined-consensus re-acquisitions); the strict cycle-1 primary is reported alongside every union value on every cycle-2 page

frozen_readings: R1 occlusion per-frame triangulated position must be DEFINED at every frame of the run; an undefined frame breaks the run (no bridging)
R2 occlusion event unit = one event per MAXIMAL qualifying run per (identity, fixed camera) pair; simultaneous absence in k cameras counts k events; runs are never subdivided

R3 mask_disappearance: camera universe = training cameras only; disappearance is a TRANSITION (associated in >= 1 camera of S at t-1, in none of S at t, so no window opens at frame 0); P (LTP) and S (containing set) are fixed at event start for the window's lifetime
R4 re-appearance = association in >= 1 camera of S (the negation of the disappearance predicate)
R5 duration_floor_frames applies to the window SPAN (first..last absent frame inclusive, bridged flicker included)
R6 a re-appearance run truncated by the window end with length < 4 is non-terminating flicker (no return)
R7 frustum containment uses continuous (unrounded) projected coordinates, inclusive bounds [0, W-1] x [0, H-1], depth z > 0
R8 in-domain visible report = non-miss, v >= 0.5, round-half-up pixel inside bounds; identical rule for identity association and the coverage numerator
R9 position_undefined_exclusions are tallied at global disappearance transitions (associated somewhere at t-1, nowhere at t) with no defined consensus at or before t
R10 consensus definedness = artifact point non-null; no n_cam threshold
R11 return distance is Euclidean 3-D, inclusive <= r_site_census
R12 min_positive_opportunity_cameras reduces to |S| >= 2 under the verified static rig
statistics.implementation_alignment: the census evaluator is aligned to these readings, with tests, BEFORE any screening statistic is computed; alignment commit recorded here at sign-off

screening_thresholds.margin_disclosure: 2x is a DISCLOSED DESIGN MARGIN, not a derivation: under half-to-half stationarity screened 72 gives P(unscreened >= 36) ~ 0.99999 (Poisson), 0.97 at true per-half rate 48, 0.52 at 36; it buffers winner's-curse shrinkage from selecting top-3-of-~20 and mild nonstationarity; it cannot protect against an event phase confined to one half - the gate exists to catch exactly that

per_sequence_eligibility.rationale: no dev sequence may free-ride: cycle 1's flip_book contributed zero returns and zero absences and pooled floors hid it; the coverage floor's own rationale is per-scene

selection_algorithm.step_1: eligibility filter per per_sequence_eligibility over the fully screened tranche
selection_algorithm.step_2: order eligible candidates by screened-half union_return_count descending; ties ascending alphabetical
selection_algorithm.step_3: take the top 3; the selected subset has EXACTLY 3 members always; if fewer than 3 candidates are eligible, steps 3-4 are skipped and the outcome is DRY within the frozen budget; test all four pooled screening thresholds (coverage pooled as ratio-of-sums)
selection_algorithm.step_4: on failure, enumerate 3-subsets of eligible candidates in descending order of pooled union_returns; ties broken lexicographically comparing each subset's member names SORTED ASCENDING as a tuple; first subset passing all pooled thresholds is selected
selection_algorithm.step_5_dry: enumeration exhausted without a passing subset => DRY WITHIN THE FROZEN BUDGET (never 'DiVa-360 exhausted' while unscreened candidates remain)

gate.protocol: identical to cycle 1: independent fresh-context recomputation from primary inputs + integrity audit precede the recorded verdict; a valid FAIL on the selected subset is final for that subset under the frozen failure policy
gate.carry_overs: revision-3 necessary_condition_note restated on every result page (upper bounds; floors necessary, never sufficient); M1-A0b audited true absence runs post-gate on the selected subset, diagnostic-only; a cycle-2 PASS restores the scientific precondition the M1 gate tested - starting M2 REMAINS a separate explicit user approval
gate.per_sequence_gate_coverage_window: computed per selected sequence on the UNSCREENED half from full-range tracks

budget_and_data_policy.per_candidate_gpu_hours_estimate: 0.06 + 0.10 * (n_frames/1000), halved for half-window tracking; long sequences use the disclosed chunked tracker path
budget_and_data_policy.checkpoint: MANDATORY after tranche 1: full interim screening table + projected continuation cost + explicit options (continue tranche 2 / R4 dataset extension / R3 descope claim-change) put to the USER; 'continue' is autonomous-eligible only if a qualifying subset exists or >= 2 candidates cleared eligibility
budget_and_data_policy.deletable_after_seal: extracted frame images only; raw zips always retained; every deletion ledgered
budget_and_data_policy.preprocessing_accounting: reproducibility only, per the standing M1 policy

standing_disclosures.tracker_legibility: selection maximizes returns AS MEASURED BY THE TRACKER-BASED CENSUS and therefore selects tracker-legible scenes; EL-GS consumes those tracks while ported baselines consume none, so arm comparisons on the selected subset estimate EL-GS's advantage in its cleanest-evidence, maximal-opportunity regime; all downstream claims are scoped to event-rich, tracker-legible sequences
standing_disclosures.full_table_publication: the complete screening table (every screened candidate's statistics) is published with the selection
standing_disclosures.controls_scope: within-scene shuffle/shift controls address evidence informativeness, not scene-selection external validity
